title: Cookiee Kawaii x Rocky Snyda dropped Seductive New Single "Let Me Rock."
htmlContent:
Jersey club meets R&B in Cookiee Kawaii's new single, "Let Me Rock." The viral queer artist has teamed up with Rocky Snyda for a sultry slow-burner that takes you on a seductive journey of twists, turns, and teases. The track is part of Cookiee Kawaii's upcoming album Club Soda. Vol. 3 showcases her genre-fluid style that cuts across Jersey club, R&B, and rap.

"Let Me Rock" is an invitation to indulge in your wildest girl-on-girl fantasy, and Cookiee's windswept vocals collide with a power-punching rap sequence for an intoxicating banger that genuinely takes it over the top. With over 2 million monthly listeners and 1.4 million followers on TikTok, Cookiee Kawaii's star is rising. The artist has received high acclaim from Vogue, Fader, BET, Billboard, XXL, Okayplayer, Flaunt, and New York Post.

Cookiee Kawaii is an enigma, an artist with love for sweets and anime, which was born into music as the daughter of house DJs. Her new single "Let Me Rock" proves that she is not afraid to take risks and push boundaries, creating a unique and unforgettable sound that is entirely her own.
